record: P4S-31D — Desktop ambient wake-word runtime compile artifact
mode: compile_only — no activation authorized; no daemon, no wake runtime, no wake-word library dependency ships with this artifact

activation_gate.gate: This artifact defines the target shape ONLY. The wake portion belongs to packet P4S-31D-3 and the ambient (always_on) portion to packet P4S-31D-6 — both hard-held. P4S-31D-6 is owner-gated and ships LAST per docs/VOICE_INTENT_CONTRACT.md. Nothing in this artifact starts, schedules, or permits either packet.
activation_gate.who_gates: the owner explicitly calls each implementation packet in sequence (P4S-31D-1 first); this artifact cannot

doctrine: The wake daemon exists ONLY to emit WakeEvents that open a consented capture window feeding the SAME Cockpit Chat intent rail (transcript -> sendMessage(source='voice') -> /advisor/converse -> classify_intent -> intent loop -> proof). It never classifies intent, never dispatches work, never carries audio off-device. Grounded in docs/VOICE_INTENT_CONTRACT.md and data/umh/voice/platform_voice_feasibility_matrix.json — this artifact repeats those verdicts, it does not soften them.

scope.applies_to_target: desktop_app (Electron cockpit shell) — the ONLY clean ambient-wake host per the feasibility matrix (wake_word: LIKELY on desktop_app; CONSTRAINED in-tab on desktop_browser)
scope.orchestrator_exclusion: the orchestrator-role node (per infra/device_registry.json) NEVER runs a microphone, wake runtime, or capture — DeviceCapabilityProfile.has_microphone=false for that role always
scope.device_binding: devices referenced by infra/device_registry.json role/id only — never hostnames or device-name literals

wake_event_contract.note: This artifact does NOT redefine WakeEvent fields. The canonical shape lives in voice_intent_contract_types.json: keyword, confidence, detected_at, source_device_id, consent_ref, wake_runtime, carries_audio(const false). The daemon emits exactly that shape and nothing more.
invariants_inherited: carries_audio is const false — a WakeEvent reports a keyword event, never audio
consent_ref must resolve to an ACTIVE VoiceConsentGrant for this device+mode or the event is rejected fail-closed
confidence below the configured threshold is discarded before emission (see false_positive_handling)
keyword is instance-configured at runtime, never a literal in substrate

daemon_lifecycle.owner_process: Electron MAIN process of the desktop cockpit app hosts the wake daemon (real background thread, no tab throttling). The renderer only displays state and affordances; it never owns the mic.
starts_when_all_of: desktop wake feature flag is ON (default OFF — see rollback_plan)
an ACTIVE VoiceConsentGrant exists for this device in the requested mode (wake_word for P4S-31D-3 scope; always_on additionally for P4S-31D-6 scope)
OS microphone permission is granted (macOS TCC / Windows privacy)
DeviceCapabilityProfile for this device_registry_id has has_microphone=true and wake_word_runtime != 'none'
stops_when_any_of: consent grant revoked (revoked_at set) — immediate stop, see consent_model.revocation
operator mute affordance engaged (suspends listening without revoking consent)
Electron app quits (daemon dies with the main process — it is NOT a system service)

transitions.on: active VoiceConsentGrant(mode) present + flag ON + OS mic permission
Electron main process opens the on-device wake runtime and begins local-only listening
on-device detector fires at/above confidence threshold; WakeEvent emitted with consent_ref
consent_ref validated ACTIVE — bounded capture window opens; transcript path is the existing TranscriptEvent -> sendMessage(source='voice') seam
final transcript emitted, window timeout, or operator cancel
revocation, flag OFF, mute, app quit, or budget breach — mic released immediately

vocabulary_reuse.note: The daemon states map onto the EXISTING AmbientState machine rather than inventing a parallel one: disabled<->DORMANT, armed<->PASSIVE_LISTENING, wake_detected<->WAKE_DETECTED, capture_window<->COMMAND_ACTIVE, rearm<->COOLDOWN. consent_granted is the consent precondition layer that VoiceSession already models (consent_pending -> consent_granted) — it gates entry into the AmbientState machine; it does not duplicate it. Transitions are recorded as WakeTransition-shaped entries; no new transition type is defined.

consent_model.per_mode_strictness: Consent is PER-MODE and per-device. VoiceConsentGrant(activation_mode='wake_word') authorizes wake-word listening ONLY. VoiceConsentGrant(activation_mode='always_on') is a SEPARATE grant required for ambient continuous operation. Neither grant implies the other; a push_to_talk grant authorizes neither. P4S-31D-3 scope requires the wake_word grant; P4S-31D-6 scope requires BOTH the wake_word grant and the always_on grant active simultaneously.
consent_model.two_layers: OS microphone permission (macOS TCC / Windows privacy settings) AND the UMH VoiceConsentGrant are BOTH required; either missing means the daemon refuses to arm, fail-closed.

revocation.rule: revoked_at set on the covering grant => active=false => the daemon kills listening IMMEDIATELY: wake runtime thread stopped, microphone released, state -> disabled. No grace period, no queued events, no draining.
revocation.bound: revocation-to-mic-release must complete within 1 second on the device (target bound for the implementation packet's acceptance test)
revocation.mid_capture: revocation during an open capture_window aborts the window; any partial transcript is discarded, not submitted

consent_model.no_silent_listening: There is NO state in which the daemon listens without an active grant for the exact mode in effect. WakeEvents arriving with a missing/revoked consent_ref are rejected fail-closed and logged to the operator-visible wake log.

privacy_boundary.on_device_detection: ALL wake-word detection runs on-device inside the Electron main process (openWakeWord ONNX / Porcupine native class runtime). No audio frame ever streams off-device for wake detection.
privacy_boundary.what_crosses_the_device_boundary: ONLY WakeEvent metadata (keyword, confidence, detected_at, source_device_id, consent_ref, wake_runtime, carries_audio=false) and, after a consented capture window, the existing transcript-only path (TranscriptEvent text). Never audio bytes.
privacy_boundary.audio_lifetime: the rolling audio buffer used by the detector lives in main-process memory only, is bounded to the detector's window (a few seconds), is never persisted to disk, and is never transmitted
privacy_boundary.cloud_stt: DEFERRED — this artifact takes NO position on cloud transcription; that remains a separate, owner-gated privacy review per docs/VOICE_INTENT_CONTRACT.md
privacy_boundary.identity: the daemon stamps NO identity; the operator Clerk principal is resolved server-side at /advisor/converse exactly as the contract requires
privacy_boundary.orchestrator: no wake runtime, mic, or capture ever on the orchestrator-role node

confidence_threshold.rule: detections below threshold are discarded on-device and never emitted as WakeEvents; threshold is operator-tunable per device within the range

cooldown_seconds.source: reuses COOLDOWN_SECONDS from substrate/workstation/ambient_wake_runtime.py — after a capture_window closes, the daemon holds in rearm for this interval before listening resumes, preventing rapid retrigger loops

capture_window_timeout_seconds.source: reuses COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from substrate/workstation/ambient_wake_runtime.py — an open capture_window that produces no final transcript closes itself

false_positive_handling.operator_visible_wake_log: every emitted WakeEvent (and every consent-rejected wake) is appended to an operator-visible wake log surfaced in the cockpit (wake count, keyword, confidence, timestamp, accepted/rejected). The operator can always answer 'what did it hear and when did it wake?' from the UI — no invisible wakes.
false_positive_handling.mute_affordance: a one-action mute control in the cockpit (HUD/tray) suspends listening immediately WITHOUT revoking consent — state -> disabled until unmuted. Hardware/OS microphone mute is respected as an outer layer. Mute state is visibly indicated.
false_positive_handling.false_positive_review: the wake log is the input for threshold tuning; repeated false wakes are an operator-visible signal, not a silent condition

resource_budget.law: CPU Gate Law (CLAUDE.md, NON-NEGOTIABLE): UMH must never saturate CPU on any host. The wake daemon is bound by the same principle on every desktop device it runs on.

cpu_bounds.self_disarm: if the daemon's own sustained usage exceeds sustained_pct_single_core_max, or host load crosses the CPU-gate ceiling used by cpu_gate_check, the daemon self-disarms (state -> disabled) and logs the reason to the wake log; it does not degrade the host

memory_bounds.note: hard ceiling for the wake runtime including model(s) and ONNX/native runtime overhead; breach => self-disarm

candidate_runtimes.notes: estimates from published desktop-class benchmarks; MUST be re-measured on target hardware during the P4S-31D-3 spike before any threshold is finalized. No dependency is added by this artifact.

smallest footprint of the candidates; requires a Picovoice access key and commercial licensing review — the licensing decision belongs to the implementation packet, not this artifact. No dependency is added by this artifact.

resource_budget.measurement_requirement: the P4S-31D-3 implementation packet must record measured CPU/RSS on the target device class and prove the bounds above before wake mode may be offered; estimates in this artifact are compile-time planning numbers, not proof

rollback_plan.flag_off: the desktop wake feature flag defaults OFF; with the flag off the daemon NEVER starts — no thread, no mic handle, no model load. Turning the flag off on a running app stops the daemon immediately.
rollback_plan.revoke: revoking the covering VoiceConsentGrant stops listening immediately (see consent_model.revocation) — independent of the flag
rollback_plan.mute: operator mute suspends listening instantly without touching consent state
rollback_plan.uninstall: uninstalling the desktop app removes the daemon, wake models, and all local wake state with it; there is no persisted audio to purge because audio is never persisted; VoiceConsentGrant records remain server-side as revocable stored state and can be revoked independently of the uninstall
rollback_plan.artifact_rollback: this compile artifact is additive (docs + data + one test); revert the commit and nothing at runtime changes

mobile_ambient_verdicts.note: Repeated VERBATIM from data/umh/voice/platform_voice_feasibility_matrix.json — this artifact does not soften them. Desktop ambient work implies NO mobile ambient promise.

sub_verdicts.mobile_app_foreground_wake: CONSTRAINED — foreground on-device wake only, under consent
sub_verdicts.mobile_app_background_android: CONSTRAINED — foreground service (FGS microphone type, persistent notification) approximation; battery-costly
sub_verdicts.mobile_app_background_ios: NOT_FEASIBLE — non-audio app cannot hold continuous background mic; App Review policy blocks it
sub_verdicts.mobile_browser: NOT_FEASIBLE — no background execution; tab suspended; mic released

mobile_ambient_verdicts.rule: any mobile ambient work requires a platform spike + privacy review + owner sign-off before it may even be scheduled — it is not part of P4S-31D-3 or P4S-31D-6

forbidden_in_this_packet: any runtime code (daemon, adapter, route, cockpit component, service)
any wake-word library dependency added to any manifest
any activation, scheduling, or start of P4S-31D-3 or P4S-31D-6
any mobile ambient promise beyond the matrix verdicts above
any cloud-STT decision (deferred to the privacy review)
any tenant or device-hostname literal as global truth
